arStrings.szText: "Have you made any progress with the blood?"
Aye! We have the beginnings of a plan. This is Davish, a good friend of mine.
She tells me you’re the one who felled Astaroth. I owe you a drink—or three.
We’ll need to consult the other Druids, get them on board. In the meantime, keep looking for other blood relics.
